title: 第二集 第二章 晏烬出手第二集 第三章 闲石苑的女子们
lines: 云江酒楼的二楼。
孟川和柳七月寻了一个靠窗的位置坐下，酒楼的侍者早就热情伺候了，他们当然认识自家少爷。
“阿川，看那边。”柳七月小声说道。
孟川转头看去。
在热闹的酒楼二楼另一处，坐着一名面无表情的白衣少年，一旁是那位老仆。
“是他？”孟川认出来了，正是那位玉阳宫名叫‘晏烬’的少年。晏烬很神秘，东宁府的普通人几乎都没听说过。但整个东宁府的五大神魔家族、朝廷官府等各方高层却都很关注这位天赋不亚于‘孟川’的绝世天才。加上有玉阳宫主当靠山，自然地位更超然。
晏烬也发现有人注视，看向孟川这边。
孟川笑着举起酒杯，遥遥示意。晏烬却是转过头去，懒得再看。
“真是失礼。”柳七月见状，低声道，“阿川，别理他。”
“他只是本性如此罢了。”孟川笑道，去年斩妖盛会，这晏烬从上场到下场，仅仅和自己说了一句话——还是为了不占自己便宜！孟川当时就明白对方的性子了。
“你就是脾气太好。”柳七月跟着拿起一大块酱骨头吃起来，“嗯嗯，你家酒楼做的酱骨头，就是比外面的好吃，每次闻了都要流口水，这一盘都归我了。”
“放心，没人和你抢！”孟川打趣道，“你这么能吃，怎么就不胖呢？”
柳七月眉毛一挑，颇为得意，继续开心吃着。
就在他们边拌嘴边吃的时候，忽然一道声音响起。
“孟川公子，孟川公子，求求你救救我姐。”一道孩童的声音陡然从楼下传来，带着焦急和决绝。
一个普通穷苦人家的孩子，在整个东宁府第一酒楼，富商高人们云集的酒楼外大声嚷嚷，的确是需要莫大的勇气的。
在二楼的孟川一听，特别是那明显很稚嫩的孩童声音，让他立即对一旁侍者下令：“去，把那孩子带上来。”
“是，少爷。”很快侍者下去了。
很快——
穿着普通，都有些脏兮兮的孩童来到了二楼，到了孟川他们这一桌旁。来到如此豪奢酒楼，这孩童还有些发慌。
“小家伙，你找我？”孟川笑看着这孩童。
孩童铁生看到眼前这位大家族公子朝自己微笑询问，原本忐忑慌乱的情绪也稳定了些，连跪下磕头道：“铁生，拜见孟公子，求公子救救我姐。”
“到底怎么回事，你起来说。”孟川说道。
这孩童这才站起来。
“我姐叫红雨，在一个大家族当丫鬟。”孩童铁生说道，“她很好的，每次回来都带好吃的给我。可是今天她回来时候，却被魏老大带人给掳走了。”
在另一桌的白衣少年晏烬，身为脱胎境高手自然能清晰听见孩童所说一切，他默默喝着酒听着，只是眼神冰冷了几分。
“为什么抓你姐？”孟川询问。
“说是抓我姐去抵账。”孩童铁生说道，“他们说我爹欠他们三百两银子。可我爹说，实际上只是借了十两银子。当时半醉又是夜里，被蒙骗着在一百两欠账的白纸上按了手印。钱滚钱利滚利，都成了三百两了。”
孟川听了点头，普通人这等事也常见。
那些地痞流氓坑蒙拐骗的事的确有，管也管不完！因为达不到洗髓境都没资格去服兵役。没服兵役……注定永无出头之日。那些流氓混混更是好吃懒做之辈，抓进牢里他们还开心有牢饭吃呢。
“你爹可签了女儿的卖身契？”孟川追问。
“没有，没签。我爹死都不肯签。”孩童连道。
“哦？地痞流氓敢强抢民女？”孟川惊讶，地痞流氓最多做些小打小闹的事，真的重罪是不敢犯的！因为重罪……朝廷的处罚就太重了。强抢民女是有断肢之刑，还要服苦役。若是太过分，判死刑都正常。
敢强抢民女，背后定有些原因。
“这个魏老大叫什么，住在哪？”孟川又问，“他有何来历？”
“我只听说他叫魏三刀，住在东柳河那边，我爹说那魏老大是黑狼帮的一个小喽喽。”孩童连说着。
孟川点头：“黑狼帮？难怪了。”
说着孟川对远处微微招手。
content_en:
The second floor of Yunjiang Restaurant.
Meng Chuan and Liu Qiyue found a seat by the window and sat down. The waiters in the restaurant had already been waiting on them enthusiastically. Of course they knew their young master.
"Achuan, look over there." Liu Qiyue whispered.
Meng Chuan turned around and looked.
In another place on the second floor of the bustling restaurant, an expressionless young man in white sat, with the old servant beside him.
"Is it him?" Meng Chuan recognized it, it was the young man named 'Yan Jin' from Yuyang Palace. Yan Jin is very mysterious, and almost no ordinary people in Dongning Mansion have heard of him. However, the five major gods and demon families in Dongning Mansion, the imperial government and other high-level officials are all paying attention to this peerless genius whose talent is no less than that of 'Meng Chuan'. In addition, with the master of Yuyang Palace as his backer, his status is naturally even more transcendent.
Yan Jin also noticed that someone was watching and looked towards Meng Chuan.
Meng Chuan smiled and raised his wine glass, signaling from afar. Yan Jin turned his head, too lazy to look again.
"It's really rude." Seeing this, Liu Qiyue whispered, "Achuan, ignore him."
"It's just his nature." Meng Chuan said with a smile. At last year's demon-slaying event, Yan Jin only said one word to himself from the beginning to the end - just to avoid taking advantage of him! Meng Chuan understood the other party's temper at that time.
"You just have a good temper." Liu Qiyue then picked up a large piece of soy sauce bones and ate them, "Yeah, the soy sauce bones made in your restaurant are just better than the ones outside. Every time I smell them, I make my mouth water. This plate belongs to me."
"Don't worry, no one will compete with you!" Meng Chuan joked, "You are so good at eating, why aren't you fat?"
Liu Qiyue raised her eyebrows, quite proudly, and continued to eat happily.
Just as they were bickering and eating, a voice suddenly sounded.
"Mr. Meng Chuan, Mr. Meng Chuan, please save my sister." A child's voice suddenly came from downstairs, with anxiety and determination.
It does take a lot of courage for a child from an ordinary poor family to shout loudly outside the first restaurant in Dongning Prefecture, where wealthy businessmen and celebrities gather.
Meng Chuan, who was on the second floor, heard, especially the obviously childish voice, that he immediately ordered the waiter on the side: "Go and bring that child up."
"Yes, Master." Soon the waiter went down.
Soon——
Children in ordinary clothes and a little dirty came to the second floor and arrived at Meng Chuan's table. Coming to such a luxurious restaurant, the child was still a little panicked.
"Little guy, are you looking for me?" Meng Chuan looked at the child with a smile.
Tiesheng, a child, saw the young master of a big family in front of him smiling at him and asking, and his originally anxious and flustered mood became more stable. He even knelt down and kowtowed: "Tiesheng, I pay my respects to Mr. Meng and ask him to save my sister."
"What's going on? Get up and tell me." Meng Chuan said.
The child then stood up.
"My sister's name is Hong Yu, and she works as a maid in a big family." Child Tiesheng said, "She is very good, and she brings me delicious food every time she comes back. But when she came back today, she was kidnapped by Boss Wei and his men."
The young man in white at the other table, Yan Jin, as a master of the Reborn Realm, could naturally hear everything the child said clearly. He drank in silence and listened, but his eyes were a little cold.
"Why are you arresting your sister?" Meng Chuan asked.
"They said they were arresting my sister to pay off the debt." Child Tiesheng said, "They said my father owed them three hundred taels of silver. But my father said that in fact, he only borrowed ten taels of silver. He was half drunk and at night, and he was deceived into putting his fingerprints on the white paper that owed the one hundred taels. The money turned into three hundred taels with interest."
Meng Chuan nodded after hearing this. This kind of thing is common for ordinary people.
It is true that those local ruffians are cheating and abducting, and there is no way to stop them! Because they cannot reach the marrow cleansing stage, they are not eligible to serve in the military. Without military service... he is doomed to never get ahead. Those hooligans are even more lazy people. They are happy to have prison food after being caught in jail.
"Did your father sign the deed of sale of his daughter?" Meng Chuan asked.
"No, I didn't sign it. My father would never sign it," the child continued.
"Oh? Dare the gangsters to rob civilian girls?" Meng Chuan was surprised. The gangsters could only do trivial things, but they would not dare to commit serious crimes! Because of the serious crime...the court's punishment was too severe. Robbery of women was punishable by mutilation and hard labor. If it goes too far, it is normal to be sentenced to death.
There must be some reason behind daring to rob civilian girls.
"What is this Boss Wei's name and where does he live?" Meng Chuan asked again, "What is his origin?"
"I only heard that his name is Wei Sandao and he lives on the other side of the Dongliu River. My father said that Boss Wei is a member of the Black Wolf Gang." Children continued.
Meng Chuan nodded: "Black Wolf Gang? No wonder."
As he spoke, Meng Chuan waved slightly to the distance.
